Pegfilgrastim was administered to reduce the risk of neutropenia. He was discharged after completing the first of four cycles.

clinician.trajectory_summary: A 23-year-old male presented with progressive cough, dyspnoea, pleuritic chest pain, and a large mediastinal mass on chest radiograph. Chest CT revealed a 10x11 cm anterior mediastinal mass causing superior vena cava and pulmonary artery trunk stenosis, staged as II with no metastases. Testicular examination and ultrasound were normal, excluding gonadal primary. Biopsy histology confirmed an extragonadal germ cell tumor of yolk sac origin with markedly elevated serum alpha-fetoprotein (17,000 ng/mL) and undetectable beta-human chorionic gonadotropin. Urgent chemotherapy with the VIP regimen was initiated. Post-treatment clinical outcome was not documented.
